name: Fetch
body:
The companion or familiar can retrieve thrown weapons.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 13, Companion or familiar level 1st

Benefit(s): You have the ability to retrieve weapons thrown by your master. As a full-round action, you can move up to your maximum movement speed, retrieve a single weapon that was thrown by your master, and return it to them. If you are tiny sized, you may only return light weapons sized for a medium creature, if you are small sized, you may return one-handed or light weapons, and if you are medium sized or larger, you may return any thrown weapon appropriately sized for a medium creature. For weapons sized for creatures other than medium, increase the highest weight category retrievable by one for each size smaller than medium, and reduce the highest retrievable category for each size larger than medium.
